help.creditsOverview: Credits are Qal Dating's virtual currency used to perform premium actions within the app. Premium subscribers generally pay lower credit rates per action compared to free accounts.
help.creditsHow: Each premium action costs a specific number of credits. When you use a premium feature, the required credits are automatically deducted from your balance.

help.creditsBuy: Purchase additional credits anytime in the Credits Shop, accessible from your Profile or Settings.
help.faqSubtitle: Tap to see answers to common questions

faq.q1: How do I create an account?
faq.a1: Download Qal Dating, open the app, and follow the onboarding steps. You'll need to provide your phone number for verification, add your photos, and complete your profile details.
faq.a2: When you and another person both like each other's profiles, it creates a match. You can then start messaging each other. Super Liking someone increases your chances of being seen by them before they swipe.
faq.q3: Why can't I see who liked me?
faq.a3: Viewing who liked you is a Premium feature. You can upgrade to Premium or use credits to reveal individual profiles that liked you.
faq.q4: How do I edit my profile?
faq.a4: Go to your Profile tab, tap the edit icon, and update your photos, bio, name, age, and other details. Changes are saved automatically.
faq.q5: How do I change my location?
faq.a5: You can update your registered location from your profile settings. This helps you match with people in your immediate proximity after moving to a new area.
faq.q6: What is identity verification and is it required?
faq.a6: Identity verification confirms you are a real person by taking a selfie. In some regions it is required before you can start using the app. In others it is optional but recommended for trust and safety.
faq.q7: How do I block or report someone?
faq.a7: Open the user's profile or chat, tap the options menu, and select Block or Report. Blocked users cannot contact you or see your profile. You can manage blocked users in Settings.
faq.q8: How do I cancel my Premium subscription?
faq.a8: Subscriptions are managed through your device's app store (Google Play or App Store). Go to your store's subscription settings to cancel. Your Premium benefits continue until the end of your current billing period.
faq.a9: Credits are consumed when you use premium actions like Super Like, Boost, Rewind, Before-Match Message, Voice Message, or Image Message. Each action has a specific credit cost that is automatically deducted. Check your Balances page to see your current credit balance.
faq.q10: How do I get more credits?
faq.a10: You can purchase credit packs in the Credits Shop, accessible from your Profile or Settings. Premium subscribers generally pay lower credit rates per action.
faq.a11: Incognito Mode lets you browse profiles privately. Your account is only visible to people you like. This feature is available to Premium subscribers.
faq.q12: How do I reset my password?
faq.a12: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password" and enter your phone number or email. You'll receive a link to reset your password.
faq.q13: How do I delete my account?
faq.a13: Go to Settings, scroll to Account, and select Delete Account. This permanently removes your profile, matches, and messages. This action cannot be undone.
faq.q14: Why am I not getting any matches?
faq.a14: Check your preferences by tapping the filter icon at the top-right of the discovery screen. Adjust your distance and age range to broaden your search. Also make sure your profile has clear photos and a complete bio. Using Boost can temporarily increase your visibility to more people in your area.
faq.a15: Go to your Messages and tap "Qal Support" to start a conversation with our support team. You can also report issues directly from any user's profile or chat.
